question: Who among the following was appointed as the Minister of Tribal Affairs in June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jual Oram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jual Oram was appointed as the Minister of Tribal Affairs in June 2024.
 
• He has previously held this portfolio, serving as the Minister of Tribal Affairs in the cabinet of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• Jual Oram is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been elected as a Member of Parliament from the Sundargarh constituency in Odisha multiple times.
 
• He is known for his work in promoting the welfare and development of tribal communities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs**

 
 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is responsible for the overall development and welfare of Scheduled Tribes in India.
 
• It formulates policies, plans, and programs for the development of tribal areas and communities.
 
• The ministry implements various schemes for education, health, economic development, and social empowerment of tribal populations.
 
 
 
• **Jual Oram's Background**
 
 
• Jual Oram has a long-standing career in politics, particularly focused on the issues faced by tribal communities.
 
• He has been actively involved in various developmental projects aimed at improving the living standards of tribal people.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the two major political parties in India, along with the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
• Founded in 1980, the BJP promotes Hindu nationalism and conservative policies.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Tribes (STs)**
 
 
• Scheduled Tribes are officially recognized indigenous communities listed in the Indian Constitution.
 
• They are provided with special provisions and benefits to promote their socio-economic development.
 
• STs constitute about 8.6% of India's population.
